compiled_state.title: [T3][UPDATE] Write extensibility invariant tests for overlay registry
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Write tests in tests/hooks/ asserting the extensibility invariant: adding a new overlay entry to overlay-registry.json (without changing verifier code) causes the verifier to check for the new findings file.

The test must demonstrate that:
1. A new overlay name added only to overlay-registry.json (no verifier code changes) is automatically enforced
2. When the new overlay is flagged in classifier-dispatch.result and its findings file is absent → verifier exits 1
3. When the findings file is present → verifier exits 0

Dependencies: T2 must be complete (registry must exist).
